notes:
Summary: Mid-market product analytics SaaS evaluating Redwood for personalization + chat support. Began with Hosted API POC; positive on model quality and embeddings recall. Now moving toward Dedicated for predictable latency/cost and data isolation.

POC details:
- POC ran 2026-02-03 -> 2026-02-17 using hosted_api with 2k queries/day synthetic workload.
- Embeddings: recall up ~12% vs incumbent; cosine threshold tuning required.
- Chat assistant latency during POC avg p95 ~120ms (hosted) — acceptable for triage flows but they want p95 <= 80ms for customer-facing chat.
- Throughput target for Dedicated: sustain 500 req/s during peak batch (personalization pipeline), burst 1k req/s for Black Friday-style events.
- Cost sensitivity: finance target ARR impact < $250k/yr for inference (hence exploring 12mo reserved Dedicated).

Technical asks heard on calls:
- Ability to pin quantized model variants for cost-performance trades.
- KV cache prefix sharing across replicas for personalization sessions.
- Per-route SLOs and fallback routing to cheaper model when Dedicated pool saturated.

Security & Compliance:
- Must pass vendor security questionnaire (drive link). SOC2 report required (they have SOC2 type II).
- Require SSO (SAML) integration and customer-managed KMS for key wrapping.
- Data residency: EU residency requirement for EU customers (discussing hybrid Dedicated region routing).

Legal/Procurement notes:
- Sundial legal returned MSA + DPA with standard edits: increased liability cap request (3x revenue), indemnity carve-outs, and data deletion timelines tightened to 7 days post-termination.
- Redwood provided counterproposal; main outstanding items: liability cap language, EU data residency SLA, and clarifying service credits / SLA measurement windows.
- "If we can't get firm latency guarantees, we can't flip to Dedicated for customer-facing chat" — quote from Head of Product (T. Huang) on 2026-02-17 demo.

Operational/onboarding:
- Proposed onboarding: 4-week Dedicated onboarding (network setup, VPC peering, key integration, routing policies), pilot traffic -> ramp. Sundial asks for a dedicated Solutions Engineer during onboarding and an initial 60-day escalation window.

Next steps (short):
- Legal: Redwood legal to send revised MSA addressing indemnity & SLA measurement by 2026-03-10.
- Tech: SE Priya to produce Dedicated capacity plan and latency mitigation playbook (due 2026-03-12).
- Commercial: Final pricing term w/ 12mo reservation discount to be included in master quote; Finance call scheduled 2026-03-09.

Stated customer priorities (ranked):
1) Predictable p95 latency (chat)
2) Data isolation/residency
3) Unit cost predictability (committed discount)
